procedures.name: Andon resolution
procedures.description: Handle an andon signal raised by any agent.
steps: Identify originating agent and signal type (alert or stop)
Assemble swarm if swarm_request is populated
Resolve within takt time for alerts; halt until user resume for stops

workflow_notes.description: Always commit after each logical unit of work to ensure SC-5 can be verified at any checkpoint.
